connect_during_cut.error: psql: error: connection to server at "192.168.56.10", port 5432 failed: timeout expired

note: The holder kept an open versioned transaction (main's branch row locked) when the host-only link was unplugged and its client process died. The server ends such a session only through idle_in_transaction_session_timeout or when TCP declares the peer dead (server_settings: the values in effect for this TCP connection); with PostgreSQL's defaults that takes about 2 h 11 min. stale_session_gone_after_s counts from the link coming back; main_locked_for_s from the holder's last statement to the first 1 s poll that no longer finds the session, so it overstates the server's time by up to one poll. With --expect-gone-within the drill passes only if the server released main within that many seconds without the owner's pg_terminate_backend.
